auth.settings.allowSelfRegistration.desc: Show "Sign up" on the sign-in page and let visitors create an account here. On the platform this opens the platform sign-up, after which a person opens their own organization. Each organization decides for itself (never inherited from the platform).
auth.settings.selfServiceTenantLimit.des: How many organizations one person may open themselves after the platform sign-up (0 = nobody). Organizations the platform creates are not counted.
auth.settings.allowRegistration.label: Registration Allowed
auth.settings.allowRegistration.descript: Master switch: when off, nobody can create an account here, whatever "Open Sign-up" says (invitations still work). The platform's value applies to every organization.
When enabled, users must verify their email address before they can sign in.
auth.settings.magicLinkEnabled.label: Passwordless Sign-in Link
auth.settings.magicLinkEnabled.descripti: Let members request a one-time email link to sign in without a password. The link is short-lived, single-use, and does not skip MFA.
auth.settings.ssoAllowedProviders.label: Allowed SSO Providers
auth.settings.ssoAllowedProviders.descri: Comma-separated provider allow-list (e.g. google, microsoft, github). Leave blank to allow all enabled providers.
auth.settings.mfaAllowedMethods.label: Allowed MFA Methods
auth.settings.mfaAllowedMethods.descript: Comma-separated list of permitted second factors: TOTP_APP, EMAIL, SMS. Leave blank to allow all. (e.g. ban SMS to mitigate SIM-swap.)
auth.settings.totpIssuer.label: TOTP Issuer Label
auth.settings.totpIssuer.description: The brand name shown inside authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy). Falls back to the platform name.
auth.settings.otpLength.label: OTP Length (digits)
auth.settings.otpLength.description: Number of digits in email/SMS one-time codes.
auth.settings.otpExpirySeconds.label: OTP Expiry (seconds)
auth.settings.otpExpirySeconds.descripti: How long an OTP code remains valid.
auth.settings.otpRateLimitSeconds.label: OTP Rate-Limit Window (seconds)
auth.settings.otpRateLimitSeconds.descri: Sliding window over which OTP request attempts are counted.
auth.settings.otpMaxAttempts.label: OTP Max Attempts
auth.settings.otpMaxAttempts.description: Maximum OTP requests/verifications before rate-limiting kicks in.
auth.settings.resetTokenLength.label: Reset Token Length (digits)
auth.settings.resetTokenLength.descripti: Number of digits in the password-reset token (minimum 4).
auth.settings.bcryptCost.label: Bcrypt Cost Factor
auth.settings.bcryptCost.description: Password hashing cost (4–15). Higher is more secure but slower. Falls back to 10.
auth.settings.passwordMinAgeDays.label: Password Minimum Age (days)
auth.settings.passwordMinAgeDays.descrip: Minimum time before a password can be changed again (prevents history-cycling). 0 = disabled.
auth.settings.passwordBreachCheck.label: Reject Breached Passwords
auth.settings.passwordBreachCheck.descri: Check new passwords against the public Have I Been Pwned list and refuse ones that appear on it. Only the first five characters of the password’s hash are sent (k-anonymity) — never the password. Off by default because it makes an outbound call while somebody is registering; if the list is unreachable the password is simply not checked.
auth.settings.dormantDeleteAfterDays.des: Right-to-erasure: anonymise dormant accounts inactive for this many days. 0 = disable-only (never erase).
